[{"insert":"Pronated Pull Up + Ring Row

In this super set, the pronated pull up goes first at the harder grip position. After the short 15 second rest, move to the ring row, which shifts you into a more horizontal pulling angle, allowing you to continue accumulating reps after the vertical pull fatigues. The two angles hit the lats and the mid-back in one set, so you finish having trained the whole back through a full range.
"}]
